text:
elaine: Uploaded new sidecar comp — header actions are Close | Export | Copy ID | More. Format shown as a tiny JSON chip next to Export. Need quick input on order, labels for screen readers, and confirmation UX.
maria: Visual hierarchy feels fine. Export needs to remain the primary CTA. But can we collapse Copy ID into More when on small screens?
tim: I'd avoid hiding Copy ID. It's a high-frequency action for support. If mobile space is tight, make Copy ID an icon-only button with sr-only text.
jess: Agree with tim. Also we should ensure Export tells users what file type. Suggest: show a visual chip but include file type in aria-label: aria-label="Export trace as JSON".
sam: On confirmations: toasts are fine for sighted users but add an aria-live polite region for SR users: "Trace exported" or "Correlation ID copied". Avoid assertive unless it's blocking.
a11y-bot: Quick auto-check: missing role="dialog" on panel, focus not set to panel title, export button missing aria-label with format, copy button lacks aria-live confirmation. See checklist: - focus management - aria-labels include format - provide non-visual confirmation - keyboard order matches visual.
elaine: Thanks. For button text: short labels are better. What about text options: 'Export', 'Copy ID', 'Open in new tab' (inside More)? Or 'Download .har' vs 'Export (JSON)'? Thoughts?
maria: 'Export' + badge 'JSON' visually is clean. Button aria-label covers format. For copy, 'Copy ID' is fine but make tooltip read the full phrase.
tim: For keyboard order: land focus on heading (h2) then tab to actions left-to-right. Close should be first in DOM after heading for discoverability.
jess: Microcopy for screen reader: we can add aria-describedby on Copy ID pointing to a hidden element: 'Copies correlation id abc123 to clipboard'. That provides context. But be careful not to leak sensitive IDs in accessibility tree if some users use shared machines. Maybe generic text: 'Copies the request correlation identifier to clipboard'.
sam: Good call. Also consider adding a small inline 'Copied' transient state that is focusable for SR: a visually-hidden live region with role="status" and text 'Correlation ID copied'.
a11y-bot: Also flag contrast on JSON chip — small colored chips can fail contrast. Ensure AA contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text in chip or use a border+transparent fill.
elaine: I'll update comps: keep Export as primary, JSON chip visually, button aria-labels include format, Copy ID visible icon+text on desktop, icon-only on small screens with sr-only label, aria-live announce on copy and export. Will also set role=dialog and focus title on open.
maria: One more UX nits: when Export starts, show busy state on button and announce 'Export in progress' in live region.
tim: And if export fails, show clear error and focus moves to a  single 'Retry export' action.
elaine: Perfect. I'll push updated frames and add a11y annotations. Fig link: https://figma.com/file/abc123 — comments welcome. :raised_hands:
